hero.description: Delivering engineering and experience across the full e-commerce SaaS stack — using AI to amplify judgment, and data to validate intuition.

about.heading: About
about.subtitle: Background & Direction
about.currentWorkDesc: Full-stack frontend engineering at ThoughtWorks on an e-commerce SaaS product, contributing to a cross-team AI Playbook.
about.bio1: I'm drawn to identifying problems upstream. Spotted a filtering logic gap after a cross-border launch — courses were returned in full, and users only discovered they couldn't subscribe after entering the detail page; pushed for the initiative and led the technical approach. Introduced Figma MCP into a client's private environment, splitting UI construction into structure and event layers, which became a team-wide skill. Built a sub-agent for parallel Azure App Insight queries to auto-generate error reports, replacing manual layer-by-layer investigation. Architecture + UX background — but what I care about most is what can actually be delivered.
about.bio2: That perspective comes from a flow-mapping mindset — understanding where users get stuck is closer to the root of a problem than understanding what they 'want'.
about.bio3: Things I've worked on: Module Federation refactor of the purchase flow (cross-team login state sharing); Chrome Performance profiling to identify filter-switching jank, optimized at both logic and rendering layers; designed a Figma API-driven i18n automation pipeline with built-in multi-country consistency checks; MiniMax AI Hackathon global award winner.
about.bio4: Now breaking these down into articles and demos — systematically validating where AI genuinely adds value across each layer of e-commerce SaaS.
